$comment: Single source of truth for balance targets and run presets. docs/balance-targets.md §2 mirrors this file; on conflict this JSON wins. Consumed by balance-verify.mjs (verdicts), balance-cli.mjs (presets), balance-card-gate.mjs (cardGate). Changing a threshold requires a cited full-panel ledger run id in the commit message.

cardGate.spreadRegressionRule: candidate pooled-rollout spread must not exceed baseline beyond bootstrap-CI noise

provenance.factionWinPct: Hearthstone/vS viable-class band ~45-55%; HS devs treat sustained >55-57 as intervention territory
provenance.worstCellDevPp: HS real matchup extremes run ~70/30; 65/35 target leaves margin
provenance.mirrorFpEdgePp: 17Lands first-player anchor +2.7pp; this instrument read +1.6 to +3.0 pre-RD12 (targets §6-§9)
provenance.decidedPct: stall-class regression guard; >=85% of games must reach a decision
provenance.presetSizes: precision lives in the rollout rungs (the graded verdict layer: pooled r8+r12 ~2400/faction = CI ±2.0pp vs the 43/57 FAIL lines); GPP_MATRIX=1000 (CI ±3pp) suffices for the diagnostic random/heuristic floors, which are not graded evidence
